input: What time does the central branch open on Saturday?
expected: Nine in the morning, until five.

input: Are you open on public holidays?
expected: No, every branch closes on a public holiday.

input: When is the last entry before closing?
expected: Fifteen minutes before the branch closes.

input: Does the reading room keep different hours?
expected: Yes, it opens an hour later than the branch.

input: What time do the self-service machines stop?
expected: Ten minutes before closing.

input: Is the branch open on Sunday?
expected: Only the central branch, from noon until four.

input: How many books can I take out at once?
expected: Twenty items on an adult card.

input: How long is the loan period?
expected: Three weeks, renewable twice.

input: Can I borrow a reference book?
expected: No, reference stock is consulted in the building.

input: Do children's cards have a different limit?
expected: Ten items, and no audiovisual stock.

input: Can I renew online?
expected: Yes, unless another reader has placed a hold.

input: What do I need to open a card?
expected: Proof of address dated within three months.

input: How do I place a hold on a title that is out?
expected: From the catalogue, or at any desk.

input: How long will a hold be kept for me?
expected: Seven days from the day it arrives.

input: Can I collect a hold at a different branch?
expected: Yes, choose the branch when you place it.

input: How many holds can I have open?
expected: Eight at a time on an adult card.

input: Will you tell me when a hold arrives?
expected: Yes, by email the evening it is shelved.

input: Can I cancel a hold I no longer want?
expected: Yes, at any point before you collect it.

input: What is the fine for a late return?
expected: Ten pence a day, capped at five pounds.

input: Do children pay fines?
expected: No, junior cards accrue no charge.

input: What happens if I lose a book?
expected: You pay the replacement cost, not a fine.

input: Can I still borrow while I owe a fine?
expected: Not once the balance passes ten pounds.

input: How do I pay what I owe?
expected: Online, or at any desk by card.

input: Is there a grace period on a late return?
expected: Yes, one day before a charge starts.
